narrative.headline: Top 50 mega-caps are broadly accumulated — 30 BULLISH vs 9 BEARISH — with semis, hyperscalers, and energy leading, while financials and select semis (NVDA, INTC) are being distributed.
bullish_setups: TXN: perfect 10.0 across flow/darkpool/blocks with $600M dark pool print
AMZN: flow 9.62 + $1.05B dark pool + $26M call premium — hyperscaler accumulation
AVGO: massive $131M near-money call premium + $1.83B dark pool — largest conviction print in the tape
AAPL: $26M call premium + $1.37B dark pool — mega-cap safety bid
XOM & CVX: both 9.4+ scores with combined ~$1.8B dark pool — energy quietly accumulated
MU: $45M call premium + $917M dark pool — memory/AI infra bid
AMD: $34M call premium + $756M dark pool — semi bull despite NVDA weakness
GE / CAT: industrials 9.3+ with $10M+ and $8M call premium respectively
ABBV, PEP, MA: defensive/consumer mega-caps at 9.0+ scores
bearish_setups: NVDA: flow 4.89 — put-heavy positioning despite AI complex bid elsewhere (AVGO, AMD, MU all bullish)
V: flow 4.03 — payments leader being faded
COST: flow 3.80 — consumer staples defensive name distributed
GS & C: financials flow 3.77 / 3.16 — banks under pressure
LRCX & KLAC: semicap flow 2.93 / 2.70 — equipment names sold vs chip names bought
INTC: flow 2.57 — remains the semi laggard
NFLX: flow 1.50 — weakest bearish flow score in set
narrative.rotation_signal: Clear rotation INTO AI/semis (AVGO, AMD, MU, TXN) and energy (XOM, CVX) and OUT OF financials (V, GS, C, AXP, MA-ex) and semicap equipment (LRCX, KLAC). Notable intra-semi split: chip designers bought, equipment makers and NVDA sold — suggests positioning for AI capex durability without the NVDA concentration trade.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: NVDA bearish here while broader semi complex (AVGO, AMD, MU, TXN) is heavily bullish — watch for NVDA-specific catalyst risk vs sector strength. Financials (GS, C, V, AXP) bearish despite typical mega-cap accumulation backdrop — potential early warning on rate/credit-sensitive names.
